# A4.01 ADR writing

## Owner
A4

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-03

## Input (reads)
Decision question and candidate options from the design or stack analysis

## Steps
1. Write context.
2. List at least two options with pros and cons.
3. Write the decision as PROPOSED.
4. Add consequences.
5. Leave the status as PROPOSED until a named person approves

## Output (writes)
ADR-<n> with status PROPOSED

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/architecture/adr/ADR-<n>-<topic>.md`

## Verification
ADR has two or more options and consequences

## Checkpoints raised
- none
